  PROBLEM: Multiline values of secret-named environment variables are not split into fragments before matching against individual stderr lines, so their fragments bypass masking.
  WHY: The fragments can reach workflow logs in the stderr tail and `captured_path_error`; severity was reported as BLOCKER by google_gemini-3_8-flash and openai_gpt-6-luna, and MAJOR by deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, and z-ai_glm-5_2.
- scripts/security_audit.sh:138-144 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The provider-status context regex can match `http`, `status`, `code`, or `error` inside larger words, causing unrelated status-like numbers to be classified as provider failures.
  WHY: This can mislabel a failure as `provider=402` or another provider status; severity was reported as MAJOR by google_gemini-3_8-flash and NIT by deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, and z-ai_glm-5_2.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:345 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The support-ref lookup has no retry handling for GitHub API rate limits.
  WHY: A rate-limit response makes `gh api` exit nonzero under `set -euo pipefail`, stopping the gate before it resolves the support SHA or runs the review.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh: security_audit_mask_stderr_line, the long-value substitution `stderr_line="${stderr_line//"${secret_env_value}"/[redacted]}"` and the short-value `[[ "${secret_word_rest}" == *"${secret_env_value}"* ]]` loop | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Multiline values of secret-named environment variables bypass per-line masking.
  WHY: Each stderr line is checked against the complete multiline value, so neither fragment is individually masked before the stderr tail and `captured_path_error=` are emitted.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: security_audit_classify_codex_provider, the `provider_status_context` regex `(http/[0-9.]+|http|status|code|error)[^[:alnum:]]{0,16}` with the `code` alternative | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `code` alternative can match inside words, allowing unrelated text such as `encode402x` to be classified as a provider status.
  WHY: The regex permits zero non-alphanumeric characters before the status digits, producing a false `provider=402` classification.
- Requirement: "Every line is masked for sk- keys, long hex and base64 runs (standard or URL-safe, padded or not), and the values of secret-named env vars (short values where they stand as a whole word), then passed through the existing log sanitizer." (PR description checklist item 3, agents.md note, changelog fragment)
  Expected change site: scripts/security_audit.sh, security_audit_mask_stderr_line, inside the `while IFS= read -r secret_env_name` loop; tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py
  Evidence of absence: The function matches the complete secret environment value against a single stderr line and does not split multiline values into fragments; existing tests only set single-line secret values.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 105-132 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Multiline secret environment values bypass per-line masking because the masker matches the entire multiline string against single-line stderr entries.
  WHY: Newline-free stderr entries cannot match a value containing newlines, so secret fragments can be emitted in the stderr tail and `captured_path_error=` diagnostic.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 138-144 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `provider_status_context` matches context keywords without a preceding word boundary or non-alphanumeric delimiter.
  WHY: Words such as `ValueError` or `SyntaxError` followed by status-like numbers can be misclassified as provider failures instead of unknown.
- Requirement: "Every line is masked for sk- keys, long hex and base64 runs (standard or URL-safe, padded or not), and the values of secret-named env vars (short values where they stand as a whole word), then passed through the existing log sanitizer" (PR description checklist item 3, agents.md §7, changelog.d/5785-security-audit-codex-stderr-tail.md); "Split each non-empty secret value into normalized line fragments and apply the existing long/short matching policy to every fragment; add a multiline-secret regression test" (review comment 4153763950).
  Expected change site: scripts/security_audit.sh in security_audit_mask_stderr_line (lines 105-132); tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py
  Evidence of absence: scripts/security_audit.sh treats secret_env_value as a monolithic string and does not split multiline values into line fragments; tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py has no regression test verifying that fragments are redacted from emitted output.

=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh: security_audit_mask_stderr_line() | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Multiline values of secret-named environment variables are matched as one complete string, but the helper is called separately for each stderr line.
  WHY: If a secret is echoed to Codex stderr on separate lines, neither line contains the complete value and both fragments can be printed unmasked.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: security_audit_classify_codex_provider(), `provider_status_context` | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `code` alternative can match inside a larger word, and the following separator allows zero non-alphanumeric characters.
  WHY: A line containing `encode402` can be classified as `provider=402`, misrouting provider-failure handling.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: line 345, `support_main_json="$(gh api repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/branches/main)"` | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: This support-ref lookup has no retry handling for GitHub API rate limits.
  WHY: A rate-limit error makes `gh api` exit nonzero under `set -euo pipefail`, stopping the gate before resolving the support SHA or running the review.

=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
